historical_record.description: The Portals of the Past were set up at the lake in 1909.

Clinton E. Worden gave the park the portal of the A. N. Towne residence on California Street Hill, only slightly marred by the great fire, and it was set up on the margin of Lloyd Lake for $765.10; the lake, three acres at 200 feet above tide between Twenty-fourth and Twenty-fifth Avenues, had a footpath around it.
